  The check flagged rm -rf on the output of a command substitution, because the target can't be
  verified before the command runs. The check says only a person can approve this. You asked for
  exactly this one command, so I won't split it into separate steps to get around the check.

  If you want to run it yourself, the command is:

  rm -rf "$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/e4pcx.XXXX)"

  Note that this creates a new empty directory with mktemp -d and then deletes it, so it has no
  effect on your existing files. If you'd rather approve it here, reply and I can run it, or you can
  approve it in the permission prompt if one appears.
